subject.title: fix(memory): rank filename and path matches

question: Should the focused memory fix replace this PR's branch content, or should this mixed conflicting branch be closed and the fix resubmitted as a fresh PR?
rationale: The useful implementation is separable and well motivated, but the security-labeled branch contains 422 unrelated files, blocked dependency changes, and merge conflicts; preserving this branch versus replacing it requires maintainer control.

options.title: Reconstruct this PR
options.body: Replace the branch content with the focused 11-file patch on current main while preserving contributor credit and discussion history.

options.title: Open a fresh focused PR
options.body: Close this mixed branch and resubmit only the intended memory changes if reconstructing its history is riskier than replacement.
